case: Ahmed body, 35 deg slant, half model with symmetry plane, moving ground, no stilts
solver: OpenFOAM v2412 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, wall functions, linearUpwind
reference: Ahmed, Ramm & Faltin (1984), SAE 840300: Cd = 0.257 at 35 deg slant, Re_L = 4.29e6
caveat: Agreement to 0.2% is partly fortuitous: steady RANS with wall functions on a 0.6M-cell mesh without prism layers typically sits within 5-15% of this experiment, and the model omits the stilts and uses a moving ground rather than the experiment's stationary floor.
